concerns.text: The plan states Bonferroni‑adjusted α ≈ 0.0033 (0.05/15) for coverage tests, but the constitution (Principle VII / FR‑007) requires the correction to be α = 0.05/5 ≈ 0.01. This contradicts the mandated statistical correction and makes the plan non‑compliant with the specification.

The plan lists an output file `coverage_tests.json` that stores raw binomial test results, yet this artifact is not defined in the data‑model (`data-model.md`) nor represented by any contract schema. All result artifacts should be captured by an entity in the data model to satisfy the Single Source of Truth principle.
